text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>, Flight-san!
I'm learnin' so much!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome.
Looking at different people to find that special flutter is a wonderful way to learn... Ah!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>, Trainer-san.
Right now... we were doing a fashion check on the people in the park.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I've been wantin' some new clothes...
so I came to ask Flight-san for advice. I don't really know much about this stuff myself.
choice_data_list: So that's why you're searching for that spark?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes. Even if I could pick out clothes that suit her, it wouldn't be any fun without her own "love" in it—

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um! H-hello, <chrname>.
...I never imagined I'd run into you again.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, miss!
Fufu, I'm so happy to see you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
What a lovely lady.
Umm... who might this be?

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry.
For suddenly cutting into your conversation.
Well, <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaa... even though you're so stylish and pretty.
This world's still way too tricky for me...

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
...So, um.
If it's alright with you, may I join in too?

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text: I feel like... I might just find my answer now, with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Of course. Even the brightest brilliance looks dazzling in different ways depending on who's looking.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's find it together!
A radiance that belongs only to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up our fashion check,
we decided to go shop for the clothes Yukino Bijin wanted.
The place we went to was—

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um... this is a shopping district, right?
There certainly are clothing stores, but, well...
I doubt they have many trendy items here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aah, is it no good after all!?
B-but... I thought this place might be best for me...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm.
Yukino-chan, please tell us.
Why did you choose this place?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I wanted mature, stylish "city girl" clothes.
But when I looked at all those different outfits people had on...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe... plain is best.
Mature clothes look lovely, but tryin' to picture myself wearin' 'em just didn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text: ...I see. There's no joy in forcing a choice that you're not personally convinced of, after all...

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
Still... what about that spark of excitement?
Even if it feels right, if there's no flutter in your heart... that's not quite enough, is it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —In that case.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's see how much excitement
we can draw out... from that "plain" look!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even with a solid color, a hint of gloss adds maturity.
Make the ribbon boldly large to act as a statement accent.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: With just a touch of creativity, even simple designs can give off a cute, mature look♪ And then—

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible. The color combination is so bold, and rather than just dressing it down casually, shifting the button position to flip it back on purpose like that—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! And it feels totally right!
Like, it just feels like *me*!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wearing clothes the "correct" way
isn't the only way to enjoy fashion.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: With respect to the designers, finding your own unique brilliance using <chrname> is just as wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I was only ever thinking about looking pretty, or looking stylish...

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'd completely forgotten... that sense of playfulness. Back when I had less fashion sense than now, I felt like I used to enjoy it far more freely.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes are sparkling so brightly, miss♪
Just like scattered jewels.
Fufu... they look as if they're about to overflow with light!

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Woman
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san...
...T-thank you!
I feel like... I've found something.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do anything at all.
This is purely the result of your own hard work in seeking it out.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Though, once you find your answer
and feel that true joy of fashion again...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next time, instead of running into each other by chance...
won't you make a promise to show me your brilliance?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I want to reflect your dazzling, glowing self in my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At North Flight's words,
the woman looked down for a moment before lifting her head—
showing a bright, radiant smile.
